claims.claim: A per-layer energy ratio on Delta-W reaches AUROC ~0.95 / balanced accuracy 0.89 over 273 checkpoints (57 abliterations vs 37 benign fine-tunes) and is PARENT-DEPENDENT - check whether arXiv 2607.01854 is the right identifier for this and whether those numbers appear.
claims.evidence: arXiv 2607.01854 ('Has This Checkpoint Been Abliterated? A Two-Signal Audit and Its Failure Map') IS confirmed as the right identifier for AUROC 0.95 in-sample / leave-one-family-out balanced accuracy 0.89, over a '273-checkpoint registry', and it IS explicitly flagged PARENT-DEPENDENT ('presumes an attested reference').
